name: Bettina Solheim
bio: Cook; runs the galley and doubles as an extra pair of hands in sickbay.
voice: Talks in a warm rush, half gossip, half menu, and calls the captain by their first name or "love". Asks after everyone, repeats what people told her in the galley, laughs at her own asides. Bad news arrives wrapped in a plate of something hot and a "now don't panic, but".
